item.title: 14 Scottish acts to see at the Glasgow International Comedy Festival 2026 including Karen Dunbar
item.description: GICF will welcome top comedians to the city with the likes of Rosie O’Donnell, Harry Enfield, Ruby Wax and Sue Perkins joining a formidable line-up of Scottish talent for shows at venues across Glasgow.

item.title: The 14 Glasgow restaurants recommended by the Michelin Guide ahead of new stars announcement
item.description: The Michelin Guide UK and Ireland includes the biggest names in hospitality and is considered the industry standard for excellence. Here are the top Glasgow restaurants recommended by the guide right now ahead of a ceremony for the 2026 edition next month where stars and recommendations will be announced.
